SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT M.MBR_CD FROM MEMBER M INNER JOIN BROKER B ON M.MBR_CD = B.MBR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN FILES F_B ON F_B.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'BROKER' AND F_B.FILE_SOURCE_ID = M.MBR_CD
AND M.MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrId} || '%'
AND M.MBR_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNm} || '%'
AND M.MBR_CD = #{detailSearch.mbrCd}
AND 1=0
AND B.AUTH_APPR_YN = #{detailSearch.authApprYn}
AND F_B.FILE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND F_B.FILE_ID IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT M.MBR_CD FROM MEMBER M INNER JOIN TENANCY T ON M.MBR_CD = T.MBR_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN FILES F_T ON F_T.FILE_SOURCE_REF = 'TENANCY' AND F_T.FILE_SOURCE_ID = M.MBR_CD
AND M.MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrId} || '%'
AND M.MBR_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNm} || '%'
AND M.MBR_CD = #{detailSearch.mbrCd}
AND 1=0
AND T.AUTH_APPR_YN = #{detailSearch.authApprYn}
AND F_T.FILE_ID IS NOT NULL
AND F_T.FILE_ID IS NULL
)
